CCIDevice.title: CCI Device
CCIDevice.description: Configuration for a CXL Type 3 device managed by ccid via CCI over MCTP. ccid reads the event settings and applies them to the device.

Name.description: Unique name for this CXL device configuration

EventMode.description: How ccid learns about new event records. Notification: ccid applies MCTPEventInterruptPolicy and the device sends CCI Event Notifications (opcode 0106h); ccid does not poll, unless the device does not take the policy and PollingIntervalSec is set. Polling: ccid sets the MCTP Event Interrupt Policy to 0 and reads the Informational, Warning, Failure and Fatal Event Logs every PollingIntervalSec seconds. Not set: event handling is off; ccid sets the policy to 0 and does not read the event logs. Notification requires MCTPEventInterruptPolicy; Polling requires PollingIntervalSec and does not take MCTPEventInterruptPolicy. ccid turns event handling off for a record that breaks this.

MCTPEventInterruptPolicy.description: Event Interrupt Settings of the event logs ccid handles (CXL r3.1 Table 8-57). Notification mode only: sent with Set MCTP Event Interrupt Policy (opcode 0105h). Bits 0-3 select the Informational, Warning, Failure and Fatal Event Logs; 15 (000Fh) selects all four. Bit 4 selects the Dynamic Capacity Event Log, which ccid ignores and leaves to the host. Bits 15:5 are reserved and must be 0.

PollingIntervalSec.description: Seconds between two polls of the event logs. Required in Polling mode. Optional in Notification mode, where ccid polls at this interval only if the device does not take MCTPEventInterruptPolicy.
